column1: # local_26 (2026 local recordings): species and bee IDs read from the arena stickers
# (frame ~3000 of each crop; AAUR = Augochlorella aurata, APUR = A. pura, LZEP = Lasioglossum zephyrus;
#  "1P+2B" = bee 1 purple dot, bee 2 black dot). "empty" = the crop shows no arena (not tracked).

# "?" = sticker not visible/legible in that frame. Species confirmed against Michelle's 2026 Drive folders (AAUR/APUR/LZEP; 43 videos, all agree); 6 tracked crops are not in those folders (see README).
